skill_name: Summarize the text using 5 sentences that compactly and accurately conveys the main points.
workflow: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company that designs and produces consumer electronics, computer software and online services. Apple is one of the largest tech companies in the world, both in terms of revenue and brand value. It was founded by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne in April 1976. The company went public four years later and its revenue in 2014 was $182 billion. Apple is known for its innovation and exemplary customer service in the tech world.
